select T1.TACTIC_CONFIG_CODE tacticConfigCode, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.EDATE edate, T1.OPINION_RINV opinionRinv, T1.REMARK remark, T2.ASSET_TYPE assetType, T2.THEO_CONFIG_RATE theoConfigRate, T2.SAMLE_AVER_RATE samleAverRate, T2.VIX vix, T2.COR_RATE corRate, T2.COR_SCENE corScene, T2.COR_RATIO corRatio, T2.COR_VIEW corView from TACTIC_CONFIG_OPT T1 left join TACTIC_CONFIG_OPT_DETAIL T2 on T1.TACTIC_CONFIG_CODE = T2.TACTIC_CONFIG_CODE where 1=1
AND T2.COR_SCENE = #{corScene}
and T1.VDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{vdate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and T1.EDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{edate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
select TACTIC_CONFIG_CODE tacticConfigCode, VDATE vdate, EDATE edate from (select * from TACTIC_CONFIG_OPT order by VDATE desc) where LIMIT 1
